properties.evidence: The check that owns this invariant asserts it on ONE tool. tests/reply_is_sent_once.rs seeds a design and calls detect_gaps, then asserts the text block is smaller than the payload and names structuredContent. It never asks the other 190 tools, so a second reply-builder living in tools/skills_tools.rs stayed green for 28 days while six tools kept the shape the change was written to remove. The crate already enumerates the served surface for a dozen other properties, which is why the scope of this one is the cause rather than an accident: fixing the helper alone would have left the class open, and a surface-enumerating check would have failed on the day PR #304 landed.
